discord.blurb: Rich embeds — level color, category, and cover art.
discord.note: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook, then copy its URL. Events with a series attached include the cover as a thumbnail.

telegram.blurb: Messages from your own bot, to a chat or group.
telegram.note: Create a bot with @BotFather (it gives you the token); get your chat ID from @userinfobot, or a group's ID from its invite/info.

pushover.blurb: Push notifications to your phone or desktop.
pushover.note: Create an application at pushover.net to get the app token; the user key is on your dashboard. Errors arrive as high-priority.

ntfy.blurb: Simple pub-sub push — self-hosted or ntfy.sh.
ntfy.note: The full URL of your topic. Subscribe to the same topic in the ntfy app; pick something unguessable on the public server.

webhook.blurb: Plain JSON POST to any URL you run.
webhook.note: POSTs { content, type, category, level, title, body, url } per event. Settings carried over from the old built-in webhook.

notifyhub.description: Outbound notifications for BackIssue — Discord embeds with cover art, Telegram, Pushover, ntfy, and generic webhooks, each with per-category filters.
